name: Zagan
source:
Taciturn and reliable, he is an excellent marksman and therefore a trusted sniper. However, he has a habit of secretly placing his talismans on everyone he meets, the way a child might place a sticker on an object.

One of his favorite things to do before going into battle is to intentionally annoy Satan and get hit once.
